relations.text_en: 50/50 owner of the Top Layer reinsurance JV

source.label: RenaissanceRe 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Top Layer is owned 50% by State Farm and 50% by Renaissance Reinsurance, although State Farm provides the majority of Top Layer's underwriting capacity through a $3.9 billion stop-loss reinsurance agreement, and therefore, State Farm retains most of Top Layer's underwriting results.
